Document does not concern digital finance consumer rules.
Document does not concern cross-border payments.
Moov's Tier 3 data centre hosting others is only rumoured, and no open-access centre exists per the author.
Rural electricity is given, but no rural internet programme or rural-urban use split.

facts.fact: Russell Southwood says the Ndjamena Internet Exchange (DJAMIX) has nine members, down from 11 in 2024, about half of them ISPs; local traffic is not available.

Russell Southwood says Safitel's fibre runs from N'Djamena to Moundou, Doba and Abeche and connects 26 cities and towns, and all major cities are connected, while routes in the south-east remain unbuilt.

TCD.note: Document does not concern government payments to people.

facts.fact: Russell Southwood says landlocked Chad has two routes through Cameroon to Camtel's Kribi landing station, a third is planned, and its Port Sudan link ended in 2023.

TCD.note: Only DataReportal user counts and an unsourced total are given, which the study never uses.

facts.fact: Russell Southwood reports that the Chad government said at a meeting in June 2026 that a 5 GB data package costs 11.8% of average monthly income.

TCD.note: The National Data Centre is only being built.
Findex 13.3% is mobile money accounts only, not adults with a bank or mobile money account.
Transit via Camtel is commercial and the Niger link is not open; no arrangement in service is stated.

facts.fact: Russell Southwood says mobile money is in use in Chad, mostly through Airtel and Moov plus independents Wave and Cashi, with 13.3% of adults holding accounts per Findex 2024.

TCD.note: Document does not concern tax or fee payment.
Rural access of 0.4-2% is given with no World Bank series or date named.

facts.fact: Russell Southwood says Starlink was licensed in November 2024 and is on sale through resellers such as Ilan Telecoms, which has 384 subscribers, with terminals delivered only to Ndjamena.

TCD.note: No startup law, strategy or public fund is stated.

facts.fact: Russell Southwood says Chad Innovation Hub lists seven organisations in its incubator spaces, with no cohort programme described.
